ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)
notes: SENT characterization centers on the tick-time accuracy and recovery from the 56-tick calibration pulse, the nibble pulse-period encoding (12 + value ticks), falling-edge timing, the CRC-4 nibble, the slow serial channel, and (if used) the SENT-SPC master trigger. Conformance is established by SAE J2716 compliance testing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Tick time
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the nominal 3 us tick (range 3-90 us) and the +/- 20% drift tolerance.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Synchronization/calibration pulse
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the 56-tick pulse and the receiver's per-frame tick-time recovery.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Nibble pulse period
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm 12 + value ticks (12..27) for value 0..15 and the minimum 5-tick low time.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Falling-edge timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm falling-edge-to-falling-edge period accuracy (single edge nibble transmission).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: CRC-4 nibble
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm correct CRC-4 computation and error detection.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Slow serial channel
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm Short/Enhanced serial message assembly and CRC.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SENT-SPC trigger
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm master-trigger-pulse timing and channel selection.
